answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one spiral weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The whisper report reveals the merge explicitly at each thread. Because of that, anyone who spins up 169 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 63 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4886 identities would post 4052 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
